C0200.title: CAC Shuts Down Over 400 Sites and Platforms for Traffic Manipulation
C0200.summary: Since 2024, the Cyberspace Administration of China has continued its crackdown on online water armies, targeting activities such as review manipulation, follower inflation, and vote rigging. The campaign has resulted in the closure of over 400 websites and platforms, the removal of 4.82 million pieces of illegal content, and the sanctioning of 2.39 million accounts, shops, and 52,000 groups.
